summary: Karooooo Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, solely to confirm the date of its annual general meeting (AGM) and correct a typographical error in the notice regarding the record date for voting eligibility. The filing provides record dates, notice distribution, and voting instruction deadlines. It does not announce any corporate transaction, change in control, or special event. As a routine meeting notification without substantive governance action, this does not constitute a special situation.
